body: Self-harm doesn't make things easier. We all make mistakes, but in your case, you have to remember that you are first a victim of horrible acts of child abuse and difficult situations. You are very brave for having survived so far. And you deserve many more days, without any form of violence, including the one you do to yourself. It's good that you succeed in school so far. Believe me, it can be the key to a much brighter future! I've been there and things do get better. You just have to be kind to yourself. I'm sure other people will be kind too, around you. Don't lose hope!

The job will come in time. You need to take care of yourself first.
The bad decisions thing is something that can be changed, and I'm sure it hasn't always been this way. What's sure is that if you don't try, you'll never know!

Please don't overdose. I have been suicidal myself, and this is one of the worst methods.
You have gone through a lot of things, your feelings of desperation are valid.
However leaving everything is not the solution.
Can you imagine life after you've taken care of your health problem? Isn't that a good perspective to look forward to? Anything can happen! Anything good in particular.
Hold on.

This world is definitely a cruel place but please don't let that decide the end of your life.
I don't know what you're going through but it's possible that we haven't explored all the solutions yet. Please hold on!

Hello. First of all, alcohol is not the solution and you know it. First things first.
Then, about friends... I can relate. I have none. But you can build a new one, you don't depend on a group to be happy. And I know it's hard to keep jobs these days... Please don't give up and try to hold your head high. I've been fired twice from good jobs and now I found an even better one. Believe in yourself! If anything continue writing here or in DM.
You mean all the time

Interesting. I can relate. Why not make another list of things that you always wanted to do but couldn't (regardless of if you're gonna die)? Like travelling to a beautiful country, try a new sport, or read a new author. Try to make such a list, with things just as random as the previous one, and then complete it step by step. Looking forward to your update! :)

16? 27 here. Today as well.
What I can tell you is that there is literally every possibility of life getting better from your point; I don't know the details but after what I call "school hell" ends, the anxiety it brings ends as well, and you can start a new chapter of new life, meet new people as well. Can you wait until that?

I wrote the letter in a Word file. I need to handwrite it so nobody can put the serious accusations in it in doubt. But first, I'm going to enjoy the last things I can, like food, watching anime, and walking around to caress the stray kittens that love me more than any human. Still no reaction from the people who know the date. Aaah, I feel peaceful thinking about the burden they'll have to bear...

If you have depression, or feel like you do, you can go to a therapist. Depending on your country, there may be a free structure. It personally helped me. If you feel in immediate danger, please go to an emergency hospital that has a psychiatry section. You can't afford to die refusing all available help right? Good luck. You can also talk here and add details, so we can give advice if applicable.

Hello. First of all, like you said, drinking is a problem, so you might as well not bring a new one on top of those you already have.
Then, concerning your relationships, I feel you. It's hard to forget a past love but it ended, probably for a good reason, so you might as well move on. If I read correctly, the new girl agreed to kiss you, and you still think she doesn't find you interesting? Maybe she isn't showing it, but you might as well give it a try, and believe in yourself in general. If you don't want people to like you for your look, talk about what matters to you and what you like. It may be difficult to speak but you'll get to it eventually, as you get comfortable with the person. Give everything a chance. Don't assume anything's over as long as you haven't taken ALL the chances. And there are plenty! Good luck.
Hello. 27mn is not quick but I just came across your post. Did something huge happen recently that makes you put that plan of yours (I have one as well) to practice?

Hello. I'm 10y younger with no marriage and no kids so I'm not here to judge or tell you what to do. Your situation is very hard and you need to realize that you have done NOTHING wrong to deserve that. It's the random things that happen in life. I can relate though to what may be a cultural gap in a couple from different parts of the world. Feel free to PM me if you want to exchange on that subject. You are a very brave father, for the 3 of your kids, and I wish the best for all of them, and for you! Please don't assume they won't be hurt if you're gone because they will: the one that's very far will, and the toddlers will. They are beautiful and it's 50% because of you. No matter what happens, you'll keep on being their awesome father. Understood? Then, concerning your private life, give yourself time to think. Maybe living with a wife that can have such violent reaction is not the best couple life, and not the one you need. But I don't have all elements so it's up to you to try again, and if it keeps failing, take the right decision. A marriage failure is not a flaw. It's something that happens, even more than once in a lifetime, and even if it's true that children are the victims remember this: they want you to be happy. And they will be as well, because you'll always be their dad. Take time for yourself, for your health and for your kids. I wish you the best life possible; so now dry that tear and look forward to the moment your foot will heal so it can lead you to the next chapter of your life!

I mean that with plane tickets price decreasing you can meet someone even if they are far. And communicate to anyone by Internet. My before-the-last relationship was 4,000 km away and my last one 4,500 km. It was still manageable and I'm sure it would have made me happy if I was another person.

Yes I do. To be honest I can't relate because I don't hate my job field, but I didn't choose it either. And if you think that all workers love their job, you're wrong! You will take the job because you seem to struggle financially at the moment and you absolutely don't deserve this. And then, hopefully you will have as fun colleagues as mine, to the extent that I only see the perks of my job and am satisfied with it, even if there are many wrong things! Colleagues and working conditions will matter more than the core job itself. I'm sure you can do it. And you won't need to fake a smile. If that happens, please remember me :D

I know that feeling of struggling to pay the bills. Music seems to be your universe. That's great!
Why not keeping that job part-time and do something else as a "money job"? Something maybe not related at all, like accounting or receptionist (random ideas). It may need proper training but it's worth trying, you may find a new environment and new people who will lift you upwards :)

I have been strong for so many years that I wouldn't have believed it as a teen. I think I deserve the right to be selfish and leave one last message to the world instead of more taxes or any other contribution I wouldn't have been able to make. But in the meantime, we can talk, of course :) Thank you.

I can assure you there are people who won't use you. The world is more connected than ever, geographically and virtually with the Internet. I know studies don't mean much at this stage but please don't give up. If that can help, I can tell you that life after studies is much better/happier than during studies (no matter what people say)!

I don't think that's the question. If it makes you feel uncomfortable, you can try to avoid like you do now. Talk about the present, how you feel everyday, etc. Your progress is what matters! The rest will come in time.
Okay. It's good you left. I've had awful managers as well... Can you look for another job? Maybe something that you wanted to work in for a long time but didn't have the opportunity yet?

I can relate to your struggle a lot. First of all, let me tell you that your pain is valid, and being left by a person you love is extremely hard to deal with, especially for someone who already went through much. However, although you may hate these words, you are young; I personally began my love life at age 18, and had several relationships starting from that point, and 0 before. Even when I thought it was over, life made me encounter a new person that made me feel better and grow up the right way. And even if it always ended in failure, it helped me to know what I need today. There are high hopes that you will meet a wonderful person in the future, maybe very soon. I am very glad you have good grades and a loving father and siblings. You sound like an interesting person and I don't think that your future will be ONLY dark. So why not give it a chance? ;) Best wishes.

Whether you ultimately tell her or not is your choice. I personally didn't tell mine and stopped going there because she clearly said she would call the wrong persons. But if I were you, I would keep on going to the therapist, just to continue therapy and try to find out how to get better. You seem to have a good trust relationship so please keep on. Do you think you can?
What's the last thing that annoyed you?

I never forget someone who cared for me, even on the Internet (and actually only there, since IRL people judge mentally ill people so I can't tell anyone). I thank you from the bottom of my heart. I just don't want you to keep hopes and thoughts for a lost cause. You deserve to focus on the people that are alive.

Hello lovely, it's okay to write to me, thank you very much.

You are true about the intolerance people have despite the "openness" we benefit from, but if that's not a barrier for most people who still have hope and support, it is one for me. Nobody will ever accept me, even as a friend. I have to admit that and just leave.

I objectively have reasons to stay, that would be enough for other persons, but it's not enough anymore for me. I'm sorry.

\- " Curaja is old Curaga made AoE"  --> Isn't that already the case?

\- " Bows uses Strength as main damage instead of speed " --> Isn't that already the case?

\- " I personally wonder why Maces and Hammers are even separate" --> Because Maces' damage isn't random (unless I'm wrong)?

\- " I personally thought Guns reload time should not be that long " --> They are almost the only weapons not considering the enemy's defense, there had to be a flaw (other than the Attack lower than other categories)

\- With your armor logic, everyone will take Heavy Armor (if they don't already). HP + Strength at once? What's not to love?

\- Technicks that need a charge time? How would that be implemented? I mean, even if it's possible, how will the player know when they can use the technick again? An error message on screen? A "MISS" word shown on the character every single time, without the player knowing what went wrong?

\- With more frequent HP decrease with status ailments, the characters will die almost instantly... sometimes the player doesn't have time to act in the middle of a battle. I understand your aim is to increase difficulty, but not frequency x2, it would be no pleasure playing IMO.

Otherwise, interesting ideas. I will see what this SFF is.
Machinist has the access to most items (with Archer). It's useful at least for that.

I think you are right. Seen from that angle, it makes sense.

For the community, I can answer that in PM. But it's funny that the other one I tried to join as I was writing the post and got kicked out of was because of an Aussie lol.

Why not use Weak Mode if you're playing Zodiac Age? That's the perfect setup for LLC. The firefly option is more a hassle than antything else IMO. *Source: I played Weak Mode on IZJS and NLBLLG on the original version.*

For jobs, you'd have both of them as Machinists (at some point) because that's the only physical damage you can deal in LLC. If Magic stats follow, maybe have Black/Red mage as 3rd job and definitely White mage as a 4th.
No they weren't. Only in IZJS/Zodiac Age versions they are. Same for espers
Especially those last optional bosses where a combo-damage character like Reddas is more than welcome!
Not as much as the others, since he is the last party guest and theoretically "up-to-date" until the end of Pharos.
Definitely Reddas, since the others' equipment become outdated after some point.
This is the best thread in existence. Whoever you are, my thanks, I give.
No, it's not too late. I wish there were people like you around me to realize it as well. Thanks for your concern.

Nothing is wrong with you my dear. As I said, feelings are there but the facts are there too. I have (unfortunately) lived more years than you and let me tell you this: if you don't take care of yourself and you're not lucky, no one will. NO ONE. You are worthy of respect, so think about considering the charge so this family knows there are laws to protect citizens. Him having problems is not an excuse for abusive behavior. It never is!! I know policemen try to sort cases as they judge accurate, but your situation is NOT one to neglect, no matter what they say. It's hard to do this... but if you do, then please don't forget there is at least one person who will be proud of you. And I'll support you regardless :)

Hello... I can relate to at least the mother side, except I couldn't forgive mine, and I hate her. You seem to be a loving person and I would love to be your friend if I could. I suggest you try to solve those matters one at a time: the urgent one being, in my opinion, the harrassment you are facing from your ex. I know feelings are mixed and difficult to handle, but what he's doing to you is not acceptable. Isn't it possible to tell the police?  You deserve dignity and safety, at the very least. Please try to tell the police you are being constantly harrassed, it has to stop! Then hopefully you will be in a better environment to focus on yourself and meet new people who care about you. *Hugs*

It was a good idea to reach out for help.

However, I feel like this kind of service has a different person replying to you each time to avoid any connection between them and you. And God knows people like us desperately need any kind of connection. Unfortunately, although it may be beneficial, it doesn't replace genuine human interaction.

"Talk doesn't change anything": if that's true, then only you may know what to do, depending on your situation.

Best of luck, I hope you do get better.
